+"""IMU feedback controller for the single balance_simple episode.
+
+Run with --steps N to advance in short segments, or without it to finish.
+The script reconnects to the one live episode and never resets it.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import csv
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+Q0 = np.array([
+    0.00458993, 0.00087250, -0.39129856, 0.80631709, -0.40994522,
+    0.00714809, -0.00932829, -0.39540690, 0.79351312, -0.39273644,
+    0.00082922, -0.00400576, -0.00154626, -0.00943361, -0.00751433,
+    0.00341249, 0.00294379, 0.00230770, -0.00232645,
+])
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+
+
+def control(p):
+    q = Q0.copy()
+    gx, gy, gz = p[41:44]
+    wx, wy, wz = p[38:41]
+    pitch = np.arctan2(gx, -gz)
+    roll_left = np.arctan2(gy, -gz)
+    # Ankles tilt the body against a forward lean. Hips provide a smaller
+    # counter-motion, while hip roll shifts the torso over the board.
+    pitch_cmd = np.clip(0.9 * pitch + 0.16 * wy, -0.22, 0.22)
+    roll_cmd = np.clip(0.7 * roll_left - 0.12 * wx, -0.18, 0.18)
+    q[[4, 9]] += pitch_cmd
+    q[[2, 7]] -= 0.35 * pitch_cmd
+    q[[1, 6]] += roll_cmd
+    return q, (pitch, roll_left, pitch_cmd, roll_cmd)
+
+
